title: Culture Live
shortDescription: B2B SaaS platform for employee engagement and company culture.
description: Full-stack application in a monorepo (Turborepo) to boost employee engagement: recognition, challenges, quests, playbooks and impact tracking. NestJS backend with feature-first architecture, async jobs via AWS SQS/SNS and business integrations (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, HubSpot, Salesforce). React frontend with an in-house design system, i18n across 9 languages via Lokalise and Zustand/TanStack Query state management.

title: Les Héritières
shortDescription: Luxury vintage and second-hand jewellery marketplace.
description: Curated e-commerce platform dedicated to reselling prestigious jewellery and watches (Cartier, Bulgari, Van Cleef & Arpels…). Features include filtering by type, stone and brand, members club with private sales, online valuation and sales support. Physical presence in Paris, Brussels, Geneva and Lausanne.

title: Lost World
shortDescription: Turn-based RPG playable in the terminal.
description: My first big project, built early in my journey. A console RPG in Python featuring a navigable map, turn-based combat against mobs and bosses, character levelling, and a loot system (weapons & armour). A solid V1 school project built to grow.
